messages:
Anna: Heads-up — we saw a spike in 413s for /v1/embeddings yesterday evening. OpsBot alerted -> ~2.1k 413s in a 10m window.
Mike: Confirmed. Looks like oversized arrays (clients sending mixed dims + large batched payloads). Our embed-splitter currently rejects when bytes > 10MB or dims mismatch.
Tara: Proposal: add a graceful-degrade pathway — try a soft-split + inline fallback where possible. If splitter can't safely split (e.g., non-uniform dims), return a clearer 413 with a suggested split plan. Avoid async 202 for now; that complicates clients.
Josie: Console UX preference: immediate response with actionable guidance beats silent retries. Show: "Suggested split: 5 requests of ~2k vectors" + a preview button that calls preflight. Also surface why it failed (dims mismatch vs bytes limit).
Anna: Telemetry needs: embed_preflight.hint_shown, embed_split.attempt, embed_split.success, embed_split.fail(reason). Tag with tenant_id, client_sdk, and orig_payload_size.
Mike: Implementation sketch for preflight API (idea):
```
POST /v1/embeds/preflight
Headers: X-Embed-Dims: 768
Body: [{...}, ...]
Response: {"split_plan": [{"start":0, "end":2000}, {"start":2000, "end":4000}], "estimated_tokens": 12000}
```
Tara: Runtime concern: doing a preflight for every request will add latency and load. Suggest sampling + caching split plans keyed by (tenant, dims, avg_vector_bytes). Pre-compute for common shapes and reuse.
Anna: Rate-limit/quotas semantics: map to "embedding-units" where units = ceil((vectors * dims) / 1024) (or based on bytes), so split doesn't change total charge. Open to naming.
Kevin: Edge-case: some enterprise tenants require deterministic rejection rather than auto-splitting for compliance. Add tenant config flag `allow_auto_split=false` and honor it in quota-router.
Josie: Rollout plan: canary to 5% traffic. Console: show canary tag and sample preflight preview. Dashboard KPIs: split_success_rate, split_latency_ms, split_fallback_rate, preflight_cache_hit_ratio.
Mike: Billing question: if we auto-split server-side, do we charge per resulting request or the original intent? Economics team prefers charging per produced embedding / actual compute used — so bill per output-vector generated. We'll update docs.
Anna: Agree — charge per produced embedding. Also update cost estimator in Console to show estimate with/without splitting.
Tara: I'll PR splitter changes with these config knobs: `soft_fail` (true|false), `max_subrequests` (default 8), `preflight_cache_ttl` (default 5m), and `require_dims_header` (opt-in). Need product + security signoff.
Josie: I'll wire the console preview card and add telemetry hooks. UX note: if preflight suggests >6 subrequests, show a prompt recommending batching client-side instead of auto-splitting.
Anna: Ops: added alert rule to paging: if 413 rate > 0.5% for 5m on /v1/embeddings, page eng-sre.
OpsBot: Alert created: 413_rate > 0.5% over 5m in /v1/embeddings -> paging eng-sre.
Mike: Quick logs example from local canary run: 
```
2026-03-19T22:06:12Z embed_split: attempt tenant=tac123 reason=oversize orig_bytes=12500000 plan=split_6
2026-03-19T22:06:12Z embed_split: success tenant=tac123 subreqs=6 latency_ms=145
```
Anna: Follow-up: add `suggest_console_preview_url` in preflight response so UI can deep-link to a canned preview. Also include `explainability: ["dims_mismatch","oversize"]` for better help text.
Tara: Noted. I'll include both fields. Also adding metric instrumentation for `preflight_time_ms` and `split_queue_depth`.
Kevin: Security reminder: ensure preflight doesn't leak vector content — only send aggregates (counts, dims, size). Preflight must be allowed under same data retention policies.
Josie: A11y/UX: preview card should include copy/paste-ready curl for suggested split plan so integrators can quickly adapt.
Anna: OK — next actions: Mike prototypes canary tomorrow, Tara opens PR with config flags, Josie adds Console mockups & telemetry schema, Kevin verifies tenant flag gating. We'll sync in the eng-platform standup. :thumbsup:
